chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Mutawakkil narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem narrated to me from his father, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Ali ibn Mahzyar, who said:

I said to Abi Ja'far (peace be upon him), that is Muhammad ibn Ali al-Ridha (peace be upon him): 'May I be your ransom! Is the visitation (ziyarah) of al-Ridha (peace be upon him) superior, or the visitation of Abu Abdillah al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?' He said: 'The visitation of my father (peace be upon him) is superior, and that is because Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) is visited by all the people, while my father (peace be upon him) is visited only by the special ones (al-khawass) from the Shiites.'

key_terms.الْخَوَاصُّ: The special ones / elite (referring to a specific group of devout followers)
key_terms.جَعَلْتُ فَدَاكَ: May I be your ransom (a common phrase of respect and devotion)
key_terms.زِيَارَةُ: Visitation (ziyarah), referring to the ritual visit to the shrine of an Imam

ai.seo_question: Why is the visitation of Imam Musa al-Kadhim considered superior to that of Imam Ali al-Ridha?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam al-Rida (a.s.) clarifies the hierarchy of visitation by comparing his shrine to that of his father, Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s.) and Imam al-Husayn (a.s.). He asserts that visiting Imam Musa al-Kadhim is superior because, unlike the universal popularity of Imam al-Husayn or the exclusive devotion to himself, his father is visited by the *khawass* (special elite) of the Shiites, indicating a deeper, more specialized spiritual connection. This highlights the Shia scholarly distinction between general reverence and the profound, esoteric bond shared with the Imams.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 66-26 Muhammad ibn Musa al-Mutawakkil narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Al-Abbas ibn Ma’ruf, on the authority of Ali ibn Mahzyar that he said to Abi Ja’far - that is Muhammad ibn Ali Ar-Ridha’ (Imam Jawad) (a.s.),

“May I be your ransom! Is the pilgrimage to Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.) superior to the pilgrimage to Abi Abdullah Al-Husayn (a.s.)?” Then Muhammad ibn Ali (a.s.) replied, “The pilgrimage to my father is better since all the people visit (the shrine of Imam Al-Husayn) Aba Abdullah (a.s.) while only a special group of the Shiites visit my father Ar-Ridha’ (a.s.).”
